systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant completing the user's task.

tools.name: run
tools.description:
Run an MCPL program. MCPL is a small statically typed scripting language for calling and combining the tools of the connected MCP servers without their results passing through you.

A program is a sequence of statements, each ending in `;`: either `name = expression;` or `expression;`. Every statement creates a binding that persists for this session; unnamed ones are called res1, res2, …. The result lists each new binding as `name: type (size) = truncated preview`. Later programs refer to bindings by name to drill in (`res1[0].title;`). A name can never be reassigned.

Values are JSON (keys may be unquoted, trailing commas allowed); raw strings `r"..."` take no escapes — use them for regexes. Call a tool as `server.tool({...args})`; tools without an output schema return `Content[]`, and `text(x)` gives their text. Fields: `x.key` or `x["key"]`; items: `x[i]`. Lambdas: `(x) => expr`. Inside parentheses or other brackets, `;` sequences expressions and `name = expr;` makes a local: `(x = f(); g(x))`. Operators `+ - * / == != < <= > >= && || !` must have spaces around them (names may contain `-`); `c ? a : b`; `+` also joins strings. Conditions must be boolean; there are no implicit conversions and no loops — iterate with built-ins like map, filter, reduce. Any error (bad index, failed tool call, exceeded limit) stops the program; earlier bindings are kept.

Use `help` to list servers, tools, signatures and built-ins, and `show` to read a value in full.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Discover MCPL servers, tools and built-ins without evaluating a program. Omit topic, or pass an empty string, for servers and built-in groups. Pass a server name for its tools, server.tool for a tool's full signature and description, or a built-in name for its signature and documentation. Output is not preview-truncated, but is capped at 64 KB. This tool creates no bindings.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Evaluate one MCPL expression against this session and display its value without creating a binding. Use stored names and field or index access to inspect results. Optional depth, max_items, max_string and max_output control disclosure; output is capped at 64 KB. Binding lookups count as use for eviction. Expressions may call tools and have their usual effects. Functions, servers and tools display only their type.

content.text: Open http://127.0.0.1/links.html, list all link texts containing the case-sensitive substring "Rust", and tell me how many matching links there are. Use the browser only to navigate and extract data; do the filtering and counting in MCPL. Do not display the full page, snapshot, or unfiltered link collection: only bring the matching texts and count into your context.
